name: עֻזִּי
summary: Borne by seven men: Uzzi son of Bukki, of the high priest's line from Aaron to Ezra (1Ch 5:31–32; 6:36; Ezr 7:4); a son of Tola of Issachar (1Ch 7:2–3); a son of Bela of Benjamin (1Ch 7:7); a Benjamite ancestor of Elah (1Ch 9:8); Uzzi son of Bani, overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem (Neh 11:22); a priest of the house of Jedaiah (Neh 12:19); and a priest at the dedication of the wall (Neh 12:42). The name is עֹז with “my”, spelled as “my strength” is spelled in Psa 28:7, “Yahweh is עֻזִּי and my shield”; it may be a short form of Uzziah or Uzziel.

evidence.note: “Bukki fathered עֻזִּי, and Uzzi fathered Zerahiah” (1Ch 5:32).
In Ezra's line: “son of Zerahiah, son of Uzzi, son of Bukki.”
“The sons of Tola: Uzzi and Rephaiah …”
“The sons of Bela: Ezbon and Uzzi and Uzziel …”
“Elah son of Uzzi, son of Michri.”
“The overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi son of Bani.”
“Yahweh is עֻזִּי and my shield”: the same letters as the name.

note: BDB's p.bx.ao counts 16 tokens, of which eight (Isa 49:5; Jer 16:19; Psa 28:7; 59:18; 62:8 and others) are the noun עֹז “my strength”, spelled alike; the name's own tokens are the eight naming men. TIPNR's Uzzi@1Ch.6.5 is the high priest (Hebrew 1Ch 5:31). The meaning is a reading of the form; scripture does not explain it.
